summary: No open table links foraminiferan genera to attached/free/planktonic habit and coiling mode: WoRMS gives only a class-level 'benthos' attribute, bforams and Foraminifera.eu are image catalogues (25,635 images of 2,072 genera on the latter), MorphoSource has 75 foraminifer media, and PANGAEA/Dryad hold lineage-specific planktonic sets. Habit and coiling would have to be compiled from monographs and joined to WoRMS taxonomy.
next_step: Compile a genus-level habit and coiling table from monographs (Loeblich & Tappan style), join it to WoRMS AphiaIDs, and use Foraminifera.eu or MorphoSource images to score flattening on the attached side.
obstacles_confirmed: Attached versus free habit and the flattened face are not fields in the census databases and must be compiled from monographs.
